_about: Thresholds for soundcheck.py judge(). Each rule: warn_/fail_ below/above, a plain-words 'say', and 'source' ('sourced: ...' or 'heuristic: calibrate'). Genre 'rules' override 'default'. Genres inherit a 'profile' (club, groove, slow, ambient). Rule numbers (#n) refer to the rule table in references/knowledge.md. Calibrate heuristics with `soundcheck.py calibrate` against PERF's own best renders before trusting a fail.

artefacts.nan_or_inf.say: NaN or Inf samples in the render: an engine bug (#1)

artefacts.clip_runs.say: runs of 3+ samples at full scale: the master clips (#2)

sample_peak_dbfs.say: sample peak at full scale: no headroom before the DAC (#2)

true_peak_dbtp.say: true peak over 0 dBTP: inter-sample overs, the DAC or a later encode may distort; club masters reach +1.2 (#3)
true_peak_dbtp.source: sourced: Spotify (-1 dBTP), TrackSensei club medians +0.5 to +1.2

psr_db.say: peak-to-short-term ratio in the loud parts is low: over-limited, transients squashed (#5)

plr_db.say: peak-to-loudness ratio under 7 dB: very dense master (#6)

loudness.short_term_jumps_3lu.say: many 3 LU+ steps between seconds: level jumps between sections or pieces (#39)

stereo.correlation_below_120hz.say: the bass is not mono: weak on club systems and mono speakers (#12)
stereo.correlation_below_120hz.source: sourced: TrackSensei sub correlation 0.998-1.0; threshold heuristic

mono_sum_drop_lu.say: loudness drops when summed to mono: phase problems (#13)
mono_sum_drop_lu.source: sourced: TrackSensei 0.18-0.46 LU; 1 LU rule of thumb

stereo.correlation.say: left and right are too far apart or out of phase (#14)

artefacts.dc_dbfs.say: DC offset: wastes headroom, thumps at start and stop (#16)

spectrum.bands.infra_below_20.say: energy below 20 Hz: inaudible rumble eating headroom; add a high-pass on the master (#17)

artefacts.clicks.say: clicks (single-sample jumps): voice steals, envelope resets or buffer bugs (#22)

artefacts.clicks_at_block_edge.say: clicks cluster at audio block edges: a buffer or core hand-off bug (#22)

stuck_notes.say: note-ons with no note-off in the MIDI out (#23)

drum_offset_sd_ms.say: drum hits wander off the grid: timing jitter (unless a Feel is on) (#26)

in_scale_share.say: a lot of note time outside the detected scale (#31)

loudness.integrated.say: outside the club-master range (-9.9 to -6.4 LUFS) by a lot; PERF has a master knob, so this is a gain-staging hint, not an error (#4)

spectrum.bands.below_250.say: share of energy below 250 Hz off the club range (78-92%) (#8)

spectrum.bands.sub_to_low_ratio.say: sub (20-60 Hz) vs low (60-250 Hz) off the observed 0.67-1.11 (#9)

spectrum.low_peak_hz.say: the low-end peak (usually the kick) sits off the 48-62 Hz club range (#10)
spectrum.low_peak_hz.source: sourced: TrackSensei 48-62 Hz; Deruty 808 median 49.5 Hz

loudness.lra.say: almost no dynamic arc across the render (#7)

spectrum.bands.below_250.say: low-end share unusual for a groove genre (#8)

loudness.integrated.say: far from typical levels for this style (#4)

psr_db.say: ambient this dense loses its air (#5)

stereo.correlation.say: wide is fine here, out of phase is not (#14)

in_scale_share.say: drones drifting out of the scale (#31)
acid lines use chromatic passing notes, but this many is off-key (#31)
lo-fi jazz colour is fine, but this much is off-key (#31)
